optimizer: Fresh Adam defaults beta1=.9 beta2=.999; normalize decoder columns after each update. No sweep, early stopping or selective extension.
natural_updates: Even steps use natural_documents[step], documents0..31. Native output KL over all positions.
task_updates: Odd steps use task_updates[step//2], both endpoints. Average endpoint intact all-position KL. Treatment additionally averages both frozen scalar and block generator response targets per endpoint. Same target set for every architecture of a seed, including inactive targets.
response_loss: Native-probability-weighted squared final-token log-probability response discrepancy, perturbation relative to each models own intact baseline; differentiate both reconstructed branches. Frozen deltas are removed at MLP1 with native Down bias retained.
calibration: Before training, compute initial mean task K and mean R over all scheduled task endpoints and both generators, equally weight all six M7 starts. One common lambda=pooled meanK/pooled meanR for all fits, published with source hashes before launch. Do not reuse architecture-specific M19 lambdas. Abort if meanR is zero/nonfinite; no evaluation data used.
evaluation: All final models and their initial states, all natural evaluation documents32..63, original/expanded task inventory separated by lexical/template quadrant and family with competence failures retained. Native response evaluation uses frozen M18 benchmark directions unchanged across kinds; report source generator explicitly, zero directions, raw numerator/denominator, margin and logprob fidelity. Check training-target retention before claiming transfer.
budget: 296192 trainable parameters each,128 decoder atoms; scalar/block active32, shared fixed union<=32 and observed mean~28.3, not exact active-dimension match. Report actual counts before/after. Fixed random memberships are a control, not discovered groups. No learned membership or hierarchy claims.
stopping: Complete all12 fits, audit source/target assignment and gradients before launch, score all training retention and evaluation. If R training fails, report failure and do not begin an optimizer sweep. Assess learned-membership extension separately from this baseline; broad alternative-featurizer/manifold goal remains open.
data_status: Familiar development data; no pristine holdout or new task discovery.
